formal_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (H : (Fin n → Bool) → Bool), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.IsMinimalCircuit (n + 1) C → (∃ y y' : Fin n → Bool, H y ≠ H y') → (∀ x : Fin (n + 1) → Bool, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (n + 1) C x = (x (Fin.last n) || H (fun i : Fin n => x i.castSucc))) → ∃ (k : ℕ) (c : Fin (k + 1) → Fin C.gates.length), StrictMono c ∧ (c (Fin.last k)).val + 1 = C.gates.length ∧ C.output = n + 1 + (c (Fin.last k)).val ∧ (∀ i : Fin (k + 1), (C.gates.get (c i)).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∧ (C.gates.get (c i)).inputs.length = 2) ∧ n ∈ (C.gates.get (c 0)).inputs ∧ (∀ i : Fin k, n + 1 + (c i.castSucc).val ∈ (C.gates.get (c i.succ)).inputs) ∧ (∀ j : Fin C.gates.length, ((C.gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not ∧ (C.gates.get j).inputs.head? = some n ∨ (C.gates.get j).op ≠ PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not ∧ n ∈ (C.gates.get j).inputs) → j = c 0) ∧ (∀ (i : Fin k) (j : Fin C.gates.length), ((C.gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not ∧ (C.gates.get j).inputs.head? = some (n + 1 + (c i.castSucc).val) ∨ (C.gates.get j).op ≠ PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not ∧ (n + 1 + (c i.castSucc).val) ∈ (C.gates.get j).inputs) → j = c i.succ) ∧ (∀ j : Fin C.gates.length, Relation.TransGen (fun a b : ℕ => ∃ j : Fin C.gates.length, b = n + 1 + j.val ∧ ((C.gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not ∧ (C.gates.get j).inputs.head? = some a ∨ (C.gates.get j).op ≠ PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not ∧ a ∈ (C.gates.get j).inputs)) n (n + 1 + j.val) ↔ ∃ i : Fin (k + 1), c i = j) ∧ (∃ w ∈ (C.gates.get (c 0)).inputs, w ≠ n ∧ w < n + 1 + (c 0).val ∧ ¬ Relation.TransGen (fun a b : ℕ => ∃ j : Fin C.gates.length, b = n + 1 + j.val ∧ ((C.gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not ∧ (C.gates.get j).inputs.head? = some a ∨ (C.gates.get j).op ≠ PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not ∧ a ∈ (C.gates.get j).inputs)) n w) ∧ (∀ i : Fin k, ∃ w ∈ (C.gates.get (c i.succ)).inputs, w ≠ n + 1 + (c i.castSucc).val ∧ w ≠ n ∧ w < n + 1 + (c i.succ).val ∧ ¬ Relation.TransGen (fun a b : ℕ => ∃ j : Fin C.gates.length, b = n + 1 + j.val ∧ ((C.gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not ∧ (C.gates.get j).inputs.head? = some a ∨ (C.gates.get j).op ≠ PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not ∧ a ∈ (C.gates.get j).inputs)) n w)
plain_statement: Let C be a least fan-in-two circuit (AND, OR, NOT, every gate counted) on n + 1 inputs computing x OR H, x the last input, H a non-constant function of the first n inputs. A gate reads a wire if it is a NOT listing that wire first, or an AND or OR listing it; a gate is above x if reads lead from x to it. Then the gates above x are g_0 < ... < g_k, g_k the last gate and the output; each is an OR listing exactly two wires, the one before it (x for g_0) and an earlier wire neither x nor above x; x and each g_i below g_k have exactly one reader, the next g.
title: Free input chain: in a least circuit of x OR H, H non-constant and free of the last input x, the gates above x are one OR chain to the output
